verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show Fivetran issuing API credentials that are themselves scoped or least-privilege. The official MCP server's `FIVETRAN_SCOPE` setting and `DISALLOWED_ACTIONS` denylist restrict which operations the MCP tool exposes, but they do not scope the underlying API key. Role-based access control appears only as a pricing-page line item, with no link to API credentials. These are adjacent controls, not scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
